description: This file defines client-side logic for Plaid Settings in an ERPNext integration, including UI interactions, script loading, and Plaid link handling.

classes.name: plaidLink
classes.description: A class managing the Plaid link initialization, script loading, and success handling.

methods.name: init_config
methods.description: Initializes Plaid link configuration, including product list, environment, and token retrieval.

methods.name: get_link_token
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the Plaid link token from the server.

methods.name: init_plaid
methods.description: Loads the Plaid script and initializes the Plaid link handler.

methods.name: loadScript
methods.description: Dynamically loads an external JavaScript file.

methods.name: onScriptLoaded
methods.description: Creates the Plaid link handler once the script is loaded.

methods.name: plaid_success
methods.description: Handles successful Plaid link, prompts for company, and adds bank accounts.
